# OSCAR-2B

Omni-Embodiment Action-Conditioned World Model for Robotics.
Public inference release for the OSCAR-2B checkpoint (fine-tune of
Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B for skeleton-conditioned robot video generation).

See <https://github.com/wuzy2115/oscar> for the inference code and
quick-start instructions.

## Contents

- `model/`           — distributed checkpoint shards (~4 GB)
- `assets/`          — 14 benchmark cases (rgb.mp4, gripper_scenario.mp4, caption.pickle)
- `case_map.json`    — case → embodiment / start_frame / original episode mapping

[2004.06165] Oscar: Object-Semantics Aligned Pre-training for Vision-Language Tasks Skip to main content Search Submit Donate Log in Search arXiv Press Enter to search · Advanced search --> Computer Science > Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition arXiv:2004.06165 (cs) [Submitted on 13 Apr 2020 ( v1 ), last revised 26 Jul 2020 (this version, v5)] Title: Oscar: Object-Semantics Aligned Pre-training for Vision-Language Tasks Authors: Xiujun Li , Xi Yin , Chunyuan Li , Pengchuan Zhang , Xiaowei Hu , Lei Zhang , Lijuan Wang , Houdong Hu , Li Dong , Furu Wei , Yejin Choi , Jianfeng Gao View a PDF of the paper titled Oscar: Object-Semantics Aligned Pre-training for Vision-Language Tasks, by Xiujun Li and 11 other authors View PDF HTML (experimental) Abstract: Large-scale pre-training methods of learning cross-modal representations on image-text pairs are becoming popular for vision-language tasks. While existing methods simply concatenate image region features and text features as input to the model to be pre-trained and use self-attention to learn image-text semantic alignments in a brute force manner, in this paper, we propose a new learning method Oscar (Object-Semantics Aligned Pre-training), which uses object tags detected in images as anchor points to significantly ease the learning of alignments. Our method is motivated by the observation that the salient objects in an image can be accurately detected, and are often mentioned in the paired text. We pre-train an Oscar model on the public corpus of 6.5 million text-image pairs, and fine-tune it on downstream tasks, creating new state-of-the-arts on six well-established vision-language understanding and generation tasks. Introduction This repository contains source code necessary to reproduce the results presented in the paper Oscar: Object-Semantics Aligned Pre-training for Vision-Language Tasks . We propose a new cross-modal pre-training method Oscar (Object-Semantics Aligned Pre-training). It leverages object tags detected in images as anchor points to significantly ease the learning of image-text alignments. We pre-train Oscar on the public corpus of 6.5 million text-image pairs, and fine-tune it on downstream tasks, creating new state-of-the-arts on six well-established vision-language understanding and generation tasks. ## Model Description (Oscar)
Oscar encompasses two pioneering research paradigms: (1) Object-Semantics Aligned Pre-training for Vision-Language tasks (ECCV 2020 by Microsoft & UW) using object tags as anchor points for cross-modal alignment, and (2) OSCAR (Omni-Embodiment Action-Conditioned World Model for Robotics by Peking Univ/NVIDIA) fine-tuned on Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B for policy evaluation across diverse robot embodiments.
